description_zh: 调用该接口创建用户组
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual add-face-user-group --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --user-group-name TestUserGroup --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFaceUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.

For example, if you have face recognition services in both Region A and Region B, you can set different business isolation IDs to distinguish the face recognition services in Region A and Region B.

<notice>
Save the business isolation ID for use when calling other operations in this isolation scope.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离，支持英文大小写字母、数字。

例如，您在A地区和B地区，均有人脸识别业务，那么可设置不同的业务隔离ID，区分A、B地区的人脸识别业务。

<notice>
请妥善保存业务隔离ID值，以便后续调用此业务隔离区其它接口时使用。
</notice>
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the user group. Specify a custom value. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户组名称，请自定义参数值，长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: user_group_name
